## src/planet/buildings/buildings.ts

[Source](buildings.ts)

Planet buildings, applied while a map tile is generated.

`rings` turns raw outer and inner ways into polygons.
`footprints` cuts `building:part` detail out of the generic building outline.
`roofs` replaces the flat cap of a supported extrusion with the tagged shape.

## Module dependencies

- `./rings.js`
- `./footprints.js`
- `./roofs.js`

This module contains declarations, data or re-exports; it defines no executable functions.

## src/planet/buildings/footprints.ts

[Source](footprints.ts)

Building footprints for one map tile.

Ways tagged `building` or `building:part` are projected into local XZ polygons.
A generic outline with contained parts is only a 2D envelope (OSM Simple 3D Buildings),
not another solid, even when the parts leave gaps. Explicit building:part outlines remain
solids. Crossing parts alone do not establish ownership of a neighbouring outline. Invalid polygons are skipped so one bad way cannot
drop the rest of the tile. The input features are not mutated.

## Module dependencies

- `polygon-clipping`
- `three`
- `../../planet/extract/contract.js`
- `../../math/frame/vectors.js`
- `./rings.js`

## src/planet/buildings/rings.ts

[Source](rings.ts)

Outer walls and courtyards of one OSM building way.

Each courtyard attaches to the smallest outer ring that contains it, exactly once.
A hole applied to every outer would repeat walls and cross roof caps.
Contours are clockwise and holes are counter-clockwise, which is what the solid extruder expects.

## Module dependencies

- `three`

## src/planet/buildings/roofs.ts

[Source](roofs.ts)

OSM roof shapes applied to an already extruded building solid.

Supported tags are `gabled`, `hipped`, `skillion` and `pyramidal`. Anything else, a
non-rectangular eight-vertex footprint, or a rise of zero keeps the flat cap. Flat tops
still report their top faces so a tagged roof colour can paint them.
This runs while a map tile is generated, not in the render loop.

## Module dependencies

- `three`
- `../../math/frame/vectors.js`
- `../../math/solid/mesh.js`

[Implementation, line 23](roofs.ts#L23)

Replace the flat top of a building solid with the OSM roof shape.
Returns the same solid when the shape cannot be built.

## pyramidalRoof

[Implementation, line 132](roofs.ts#L132)

Pyramidal roof for a single star-shaped outline that has more than four corners.
Separate outer rings and courtyards cannot share one apex, so those solids are refused
and the caller keeps the flat cap.

```ts
pyramidalRoof(g: SolidGeometry, tags: Record<string, string>): RoofResult | undefined
```
